description: Ordered Update batches of the storage program and the 4-ary member record tree they move. A write is the RecordWriteData the batch carries, read through storage_entry, with entry hash Poseidon(CRQW, member, mask, value, mint_policy_write, withdrawal_threshold, limits_0, limits_1, limits_2). Each update folds chain(p) = Poseidon(chain(p - 1), entry_p) from chain(-1) = chain_start = HashChain4(CRAP, hash_bytes(registry), revision), the revision counting earlier updates from zero. proof_inputs hold the apply circuit's inputs per write. Paths list three siblings per level, leaf level first, in ascending child order. Produced by program-libs/member-registry/tests/ring_records_vector.rs.
